title: Initial communication pilot

result: Final IID48.7%, held44.8%; basic acquisition gate failed.

title: Online nuisance-geometry control
execution: One matched seed,8,000 updates; finite versus online geometry.
result: IID joint48.67→92.94%, orientation53.09→96.55%; held joint44.79→44.21%.
lesson: Online geometry repaired most IID generalization but not held-out role transfer.
limit: One seed; no mechanistic attribution beyond this controlled change.

result: IID joint49.33%, held24.80%; object permutation agreement96.18%, below99% gate.

title: Oracle-channel listener
execution: One oracle listener,8,000 updates.
result: Familiar behavior nearly perfect; held H–H role/joint around48–50% while event preserved.
lesson: A role-transfer failure remained after removing communication learning.

title: Initial candidate-state probe
execution: Frozen D1 candidate-state decoders.
result: Object-slot and null-control validation failed.
lesson: The probe could not support information-absence claims.
limit: Invalid diagnostic, not a negative representation result.

title: Repaired candidate-state probe
execution: Full-support weighting and six-slot marginalization repair.
result: Linear and small MLP probes still missed familiar endpoint gates.
lesson: The tested decoder classes did not reliably recover the target.
limit: Failure of selected decoders does not show the information is absent.

title: Oracle-conditioned relational matchability
execution: Bilinear and fixed MLP compatibility models.
result: Familiar behavior validity thresholds failed.
lesson: No reliable compact matchability account emerged.
limit: Bounded probe-class negative, not absence of distributed computation.

title: Frozen exact-computation replay
execution: 64,704 archived predictions replayed.
result: Within-H final query contrasts compressed and candidate alternatives nearly indifferent; universal-corruption criterion not met.
lesson: The defect was selective in the measured contrasts.
limit: Compression is not identified as a unique causal mechanism.

title: Support-topology relocation
execution: 24 models, four topology conditions × six seeds; two frozen relocation interactions.
result: Both primary relocation interactions passed; compression/redirection moved with withheld graph role.
lesson: Training-support structure causally shapes transfer in this synthetic oracle system, beyond fixed identity labels.
limit: No universal graph law or pretrained-language mechanism; foundation copy is the same study.

title: Exposure-matched discriminative demand
execution: 12 trained models.
result: Repeated-PAD neutral gate failed.
lesson: The intended causal training comparison was not valid.
limit: Do not use descriptive contrasts to confirm or refute the hypothesis.

title: Initial candidate-only decoder
execution: Exhaustive candidate-only decoder validation.
result: Original validation failed.
lesson: The control needed repair before scientific use.
limit: Original run remains invalid.

result: 8,190/16,128=50.78%, above25% four-way chance.
lesson: Candidate-set information could explain above-chance neutral behavior.
limit: D6 remains invalid; candidate-only success does not explain every model decision.

title: First operation-level discovery
execution: Discovery seeds only; input, first-attention and patch/ablation diagnostics.
result: Identity information persisted locally; first query-CLS gap at block0 attention; broad suppression nonselective; natural patches did not rescue.
lesson: Availability and effective causal use differed in the tested model.
limit: Adaptive discovery; no unique operation or protected-seed confirmation.

title: Candidate/query operation follow-up
execution: Query-only, candidate-only and joint endpoint patches.
result: Candidate CLS gap at block1 attention; query-only null, candidate harmful, joint role-opposed but not donor-specific.
lesson: No clean single-path endpoint mechanism emerged.
limit: Broad full-state interference and distributed computation remain live alternatives.

title: Planned D8B/C confirmation
execution: No completed D8B/C execution evidenced.
result: Later protected-seed causal confirmation did not run.

limit: Protected checkpoints and reserved examples remain closed.

execution: 16 models, eight paired seeds.
result: All16 failed ≥.99 object-slot invariance; P1 descriptive direction opposite, P2 mixed, P3 small.
lesson: The intended causal comparison was invalid despite completed training.

title: Predictive-compression audit
execution: 12 discovery models,73,728 score cells,51-coefficient interpolation and larger state surrogates.
result: M1 score RMSE3.553 versus4.751 constant; relevant-token state3.133 versus CLS3.686, all12 improved.

title: Matched-budget residual comparison
execution: 32/64/128/256 incremental coefficients, semantic versus internal-state residual arms.
result: Internal additive arm mathematically cannot predict mixed query×candidate differences; primary comparison invalid.
lesson: Equal coefficient count does not imply matched target expressivity.
limit: Nominal P2.2-A category is not a licensed scientific result.

title: Interaction-capable residual repair
execution: Same12 atlases; interaction-capable matched budgets.
result: Internal advantage only at256 coefficients,10/12 models per primary holdout; categoryD.
lesson: Rich internal interactions predict some residuals, without a compact-rule result.
limit: Previously observed discovery set; raw cross-seed/specificity limitations.

title: Participant specificity of residuals
execution: Exact P2.3 replay plus matched other/distractor/global/role-swap controls.
result: Only7–8/12 favor participant state; seed1703 reverses; role-swap/global comparable; categoryD.
lesson: The internal signal was not reliably specific to true participant assignment.
limit: No claim that all relational representations are absent.

title: Functional-response compression
execution: Four response families, matched four-coefficient descriptions plus richer references.
result: Functional beats semantic4/4 query cells but0/4 candidate cells; richer M1 wins5/8; categoryD.
lesson: Functional signatures helped selectively but were not a generally better economical description.
limit: Six score observations per test block are additional information/cost.

title: Matched query/candidate asymmetry
execution: Matched response library, scale, cost and semantic information.
result: Query-minus-candidate relative gain −.1680/−.1640; proposed query advantage failed; categoryD.
lesson: The earlier side split was sensitive to measurement construction.
limit: Not evidence that both sides implement identical computations.

title: Residual demand factorization
execution: Eight-coefficient residual correction; exact saved-score reanalysis.
result: Two-component endpoint/event correction failed to beat undifferentiated same-budget control; categoryD.
lesson: Task-defined components were not privileged under this predictor.
limit: No conclusion of a single underlying neural mechanism.

title: Residual invariance/reuse
execution: Frozen eight-coefficient R3 across six axes and recombinations.
result: Single-axis and identity×event benefit; strongest triple catastrophic; formal categoryA broader than strongest evidence.
lesson: A small residual predictor reuses within bounded domains.
limit: Successful recombination lacked control specificity; not a causal computational primitive.

result: Broad IE/IC/EC improve all12; nearest IE NRMSE15.2682 and triple14.7947 fail all12; controls similar on important cells; categoryE.
lesson: Ordinary extrapolation and comparator weaknesses explain apparent composition boundaries.
limit: No clean interaction-order law; sparse strict distance matching; disclosed control-timing deviation.
